site.name: PropertyReg
welcome.title: Home
welcome.hero_title: Municipal property registration focused on the day-to-day work of the IPTU office.
welcome.hero_description: Register taxpayers and municipal properties in an objective interface designed for public servants responsible for registration and consultation of tax-related records.
welcome.people_summary: Register taxpayers and keep their personal data updated for office consultation.
welcome.properties_summary: Link properties to their owners and keep municipal records organized.
welcome.workflow_summary: Taxpayer, property, and consultation in the same operational base.
welcome.step_one_description: Create the owner record with CPF, personal data, and contact information.
welcome.step_two_description: Associate the property with the taxpayer and keep address and identification data organized.
welcome.step_three_description: Consult existing records and keep information accurate throughout daily operations.
welcome.audience_description: Interface designed for municipal treasury staff who work with property registration and IPTU service routines.
welcome.people_description: Store names, CPF, gender, birth date, phone, and email with built-in validation.
welcome.properties_description: Organize street, number, neighborhood, complement, and owner relationship details.
welcome.security_description: Navigation, language, and visual structure were arranged to support clarity and productivity in administrative routines.
